summary: HUD warning message display. Guarded by the pending-warning flag at this+0x30 (blocks when nonzero), a2 being non-NULL, and the penalty-state flag at obj+0x32C8 (read through *this, blocks when nonzero). Looks up the 'Warning' token in the string table, copies it into the shared buffer byte_5EC4CC, snapshots it into a local buffer, conditionally replaces it with the a2 message text, formats '%s %s' into a 192-byte buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, and renders it with TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, ...). Returns the flag value originally read from this+0x30.

local_names.v3: copy-loop index over the aWarning string
local_names.v6: local 64-byte buffer holding the 'Warning' text snapshot
local_names.v7: local 64-byte buffer holding the final message text snapshot

operations.description: Seed v2 = this[12] (the pending-warning flag at this+0x30).
Block the whole body when this+0x30 (v2) is nonzero, i.e. a warning is already pending.
Block when the message text a2 is NULL.
Load v2 = *this, the pointer to the penalty-state object held at this+0x0.
Block when the penalty-state flag at obj+0x32C8 (read as *( *this + 0x32C8 )) is nonzero.
If BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aWarning, byte_5EC4CC) succeeds, the 'Warning' token is found in the string table indexed by byte_5EC4C0.
Copy the aWarning string into byte_5EC4CC byte by byte until the NUL terminator is copied.
sub_587DD0(v6, byte_5EC4CC, 63) copies at most 63 bytes of the warning text into local v6, then v6[63] = 0 forces a terminator.
If BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, a2, byte_5EC4CC) succeeds, strcpy(byte_5EC4CC, a2) replaces the shared buffer with the incoming message text.
sub_587DD0(v7, byte_5EC4CC, 63) copies at most 63 bytes of the final message text into local v7, then v7[63] = 0 forces a terminator.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v8, "%s %s", v6, v7) formats the 'Warning' prefix and the message into local v8 with overflow protection.
LOBYTE(v2) = TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, (int)v8, 3, 16909060); the render result overwrites the low byte of the return value.
Return v2 (the flag originally read from this+0x30, or its render-overwritten low byte).
